# Mohor Clothings

Mohor Clothings is a heritage womenswear boutique from Sylhet, Bangladesh,
selling three-piece sets, kurtis, khadi and sarees with cash on delivery
across Bangladesh.

## Important pages

- [Shop](https://mohor.me/shop)
- [About Mohor](https://mohor.me/about)
- [Delivery and returns policy](https://mohor.me/policy)
- [Shopping cart](https://mohor.me/cart)
- [Customer account](https://mohor.me/account)

## Delivery and contact

Delivery costs ৳70 inside Sylhet City and ৳140 outside. Customers can request
an exchange within 24 hours of delivery for eligible unworn pieces.
WhatsApp and phone support: [+8801330113027](https://wa.me/8801330113027).
